---
title: "About me"
---

I am a computer scientist working at the intersection of
**machine learning, scientific computing and ecological modelling**.

I completed my PhD in Computer Science at
[Université de La Réunion](https://www.univ-reunion.fr/),
in collaboration with [CIRAD](https://www.cirad.fr/).

I will join the [LBBE](https://lbbe.univ-lyon1.fr/) at
[Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1](https://www.univ-lyon1.fr/)
as a postdoctoral researcher.

My research focuses on the development of machine learning and
scientific machine learning methods for environmental and ecological
applications.

## Research interests

- Physics-Informed Neural Networks
- Surrogate and Hybrid Modelling
- Machine Learning for Ecology
- Data Preprocessing
